The weight is `[3, 1]` but the input has 4 features, so `matmul(x, w)` has no result type. `modelspec check` refuses the file before anything runs, and `train` refuses it the same way. [Read a diagnostic](../guides/read-a-diagnostic.md) walks through the output.

The output below was recorded by `modelspec-docs` running the `modelspec` command line on the model; `task docs-check` fails when a run prints anything else.

## The model

[`crates/modelspec-docs/models/matmul_mismatch.mspec`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/crates/modelspec-docs/models/matmul_mismatch.mspec):

```modelspec title="crates/modelspec-docs/models/matmul_mismatch.mspec"
model Mismatch {
    param w: Tensor<f32, [3, 1]> = xavier_uniform();

    fn forward(x: Tensor<f32, [8, 4]>)
        -> Tensor<f32, [8, 1]> {
        return matmul(x, w);
    }
}

train Fit {
    model = Mismatch;
    input x: Tensor<f32, [8, 4]>;
    target y: Tensor<f32, [8, 1]>;
    loss = mse(model.forward(x), y);
    optimizer = sgd(lr = 0.1);
    steps = 10;
    seed = 1;
    device = cpu;
}
```

## Runs

### `modelspec check crates/modelspec-docs/models/matmul_mismatch.mspec`

Exit status `1`.

stderr:

```text
E-TYPE-012: matmul contracting dimension mismatch
  crates/modelspec-docs/models/matmul_mismatch.mspec:6:16
  lhs: Tensor<f32, [8, 4]>
  rhs: Tensor<f32, [3, 1]>
  expected rhs dimension[0] = 4; got 3
```

### `modelspec train crates/modelspec-docs/models/matmul_mismatch.mspec --backend cpu`

Exit status `1`.

stderr:

```text
E-TYPE-012: matmul contracting dimension mismatch
  crates/modelspec-docs/models/matmul_mismatch.mspec:6:16
  lhs: Tensor<f32, [8, 4]>
  rhs: Tensor<f32, [3, 1]>
  expected rhs dimension[0] = 4; got 3
```
